descriptions.technical_requirement_alignment: Mean alignment of candidate evidence to job requirements
descriptions.responsibility_alignment: Past professional responsibilities alignment to job requirements
descriptions.role_alignment: Semantic similarity of candidate role title to target position
descriptions.seniority_alignment: Seniority tier match (junior, mid, senior, lead)
descriptions.semantic_skill_coverage: Proportion of requirements meeting evidence threshold
descriptions.explicit_skill_match_ratio: Proportion of job skills explicitly matched in candidate resume
descriptions.related_skill_match_ratio: Proportion of skills inferred via ontology parent/adjacent relationships
descriptions.true_skill_gap_ratio: Proportion of requirements with no explicit or inferred evidence
descriptions.skill_ontology_coverage: Multi-tiered ontology coverage weighting explicit and transferable skills
descriptions.missing_requirement_semantic_gap: Magnitude of semantic deficiency in least-evidenced requirements
descriptions.experience_alignment: Candidate experience years vs job requirements ratio (non-penalizing for exceeding)
descriptions.experience_compatibility_score: Dedicated experience compatibility score distinguishing matches and gaps
descriptions.experience_exceeds_requirement: Binary indicator for candidate tenure exceeding minimum requirements
descriptions.experience_gap: Numerical tenure deficit in years relative to minimum requirements
descriptions.education_alignment: Degree level and quantitative qualification compatibility
descriptions.project_alignment: Relevance of technical projects to target job responsibilities
descriptions.project_depth: Depth, specificity, and density of technical projects
descriptions.project_skill_evidence: Metric density and practical execution backing claimed skills
descriptions.resume_completeness: Structural presence of summary, skills, experience, projects, education
